# Writing Practice

> A writing coach that researches a subject and responds to drafts without writing the piece for its author. Every piece has its own persistent celld Durable Object containing the page, brief, note stream, and background work.

Writing Practice uses GitHub for identity, Polar for subscription billing, and OpenAI for live research and coaching. A deterministic local provider exercises the workflow without model credentials. The source is published for inspection under an all-rights-reserved license.

## Pages

- [Home](https://writing.krasnoperov.me/): sign in and write
- [Pricing](https://writing.krasnoperov.me/pricing): the plan and session allowance
- [Privacy](https://writing.krasnoperov.me/privacy): stored data, processors, and deletion

## Design principles

- One named Durable Object per piece; one account object per writer.
- The writer authors every word. There is no automatic apply or rewrite control.
- Model work starts only when the writer starts a piece or explicitly requests a coach pass; typing and saving never call the model.
- Prompt contracts live in source and provider conversation state is never authoritative.
- Margin notes are accepted only when their quoted anchors occur in the submitted draft.
